lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured series of high-luminance, sub-circular pixel clusters arranged in three primary horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. Smaller, higher-density clusters are visible within the vertical columns of the gill slit dividers.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like alignment of high-luminance nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient consisting of high-intensity upper boundaries and shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae (remoras) characterized by high-contrast horizontal banding, located inferior to the pectoral fin and along the lower ventral field.
